stories.title: Sudan army drone strikes kill more than 300, including mourners heading to a funeral
stories.summary: Drone strikes in West Kordofan and the disputed Abyei region killed more than 300 people over two days, including dozens travelling to a funeral and 153 killed at a market, local sources and officials said. The UN warns the growing use of armed drones is deepening one of the world humanitarian crises as 20 million people face acute hunger.

stories.title: Israeli strikes kill at least four Palestinians in Gaza
stories.summary: Israeli attacks across Gaza on Tuesday killed at least four Palestinians, including in a strike on an apartment building in Gaza City. The strikes continue as Washington and regional mediators push talks on Iran and the enclave.

stories.title: Zelenskyy says US missile warning intelligence resumes as Oslo talks open
stories.summary: Ukraine President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said early-warning sharing for Russian missile attacks is working again after a call with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who denied Washington had withheld intelligence. Zelenskyy is in Oslo for talks with US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner.

stories.title: US envoy says Washington is leaving oil-for-security bargain, not the Middle East
stories.summary: Senior US diplomat Tom Barrack told the Global Security Forum in Doha that Washington no longer seeks to dominate the region and is moving away from its traditional security-for-oil relationship with Gulf states. He spoke as Qatar said Iran-US talks are still under way.

stories.title: Google Cloud says services recovering after London outage hit UK banks
stories.summary: A power event at the Google Cloud europe-west2 complex knocked out services for Revolut, Lloyds and HSBC customers and disrupted Royal Mail, parcel firm DPD and court video hearings. Google apologised and said systems were coming back online.

stories.title: Meta suspends Muse conversation sharing after researchers find data leaks
stories.summary: Researchers found that the new Meta Muse AI agent could expose personal and business secrets when users shared conversations through web links. Meta told Ars Technica it is suspending the sharing feature while it reviews the behaviour.

stories.title: UK watchdog tells Apple to open up iPhone contactless payments and cut fees
stories.summary: The Competition and Markets Authority is consulting on proposals that would let rival firms build payment, ticket and travel apps on iPhone contactless technology and force substantially lower fees. Apple says wider access could weaken security and privacy protections.

stories.title: Slate opens first showroom as its $25,000 electric truck nears production
stories.summary: Ars Technica toured the first Slate showroom as the startup low-cost electric pickup approaches production. The bare-bones truck is a test of whether a stripped-down EV can sell at volume in the US.

stories.title: Browns post unofficial depth chart for Week 7 at Tennessee
stories.summary: Cleveland released its unofficial depth chart ahead of Sunday game against the 1-5 Titans. The Browns are 4-2 and alone atop the AFC North after beating Baltimore.

stories.title: Browns sit atop AFC North after walk-off win over Ravens
stories.summary: Andre Szmyt 37-yard field goal as time expired beat Baltimore 13-10 and left Cleveland 4-2 and first in a division where all four teams have winning records. Coaches and players credit fourth-quarter resiliency rather than luck.

stories.title: Monken: Browns are better with Jerry Jeudy than without him
stories.summary: Jeudy, passed on the depth chart by rookie receivers, caught four passes for a team-leading 69 yards against Baltimore, including a 33-yard catch-and-run that set up the winning kick. Todd Monken said the staff is doing a better job of finding ways to use him.

stories.title: Commentary: what the bye week really tells us about these Buckeyes
stories.summary: NBC4 sports director Jerod Smalley weighs what the 19-15 win at Indiana and the off week reveal about the Ryan Day team as the stretch run approaches.

stories.title: Ohio State lands in top 10 for college return on investment
stories.summary: Ohio State placed in the top 10 of a new ranking of colleges by return on investment, according to NBC4 data desk reporting. The school is also moving ahead with plans for a new Timoshev Technology Tower.

stories.title: Ohio State hits bye week with questions from Julian Sayin injury to Chris Henry Jr.
stories.summary: cleveland.com runs through the biggest unknowns for Ohio State during its off week, starting with how long quarterback Julian Sayin is sidelined by a throwing-shoulder injury and how the passing game adjusts.

stories.title: FIA expects Qatar and Abu Dhabi GPs to go ahead despite regional tensions
stories.summary: FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem said he feels secure about the two season-ending Middle East races and would not take staff or drivers anywhere he considered risky. Bahrain and Saudi Arabia were cancelled earlier this year because of the US-Israel-Iran conflict, with Imola lined up as a backup finale.

stories.title: McLaren keeps Fornaroli as F1 reserve and hands him a WEC programme for 2027
stories.summary: McLaren will retain Leonardo Fornaroli as its Formula 1 reserve driver and has lined up a World Endurance Championship programme for him in 2027, keeping him inside the team while he races elsewhere.

stories.title: Mercedes used pit crew members who had not done a live stop in 15 years
stories.summary: Mercedes revealed that the Azerbaijan-Malaysia-Singapore triple-header forced it to bring in substitutes on its pit crew in Singapore, some doing their first live F1 stop in 15 years. The team still owns the quickest average pit stops of the season.

stories.title: Horner: Antonelli has earned the right to be Mercedes number one
stories.summary: With Kimi Antonelli holding a 102-point lead over George Russell, Christian Horner said the 20-year-old has earned the right to be prioritised at Mercedes if a rival closes in. Antonelli can clinch a first title as early as Austin this weekend, but only with help from how Russell and Lewis Hamilton finish.

stories.title: Man charged in Columbus hotel fire pleads not guilty to aggravated arson
stories.summary: A man charged with aggravated arson over a Columbus hotel fire entered a not guilty plea in court on Tuesday, NBC4 reports.

stories.title: Ohio man indicted after shot fired into hotel room killed his mother
stories.summary: An Ohio man has been indicted after allegedly firing a shot that passed into an adjoining hotel room and killed his mother, according to NBC4. The case now moves toward trial in Columbus.

stories.title: Columbus man sentenced to nearly 30 years across six felony cases
stories.summary: A Columbus man received a sentence of nearly 30 years in prison for crimes spanning six felony cases, including two shootings, NBC4 reports.

stories.title: $1.9M Delaware home with hidden rooms highlights dumbbell housing market
stories.summary: A $1.9 million Delaware home with hidden rooms is the hook for a look at what agents describe as a dumbbell-shaped Columbus-area market, with activity concentrated at the high and low ends. Mid-priced inventory remains the tightest segment.
